# Ecosystem Intelligence Group — AI Context File
# https://www.ecosystemintelligencegroup.com/llms.txt

## About Ecosystem Intelligence Group

Ecosystem Intelligence Group (EIG) is an advisory firm that helps organisations, industries and governments transform data, expertise and insight into measurable value, stronger performance and better decisions.

EIG operates at the intersection of Ecosystem Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, Sustainability Economics, Value Creation, Supply Chain & Procurement, and Transformation & Leadership.

EIG is part of the SIB Group and is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Contact: Team@EIG.com

## What EIG Does

- Ecosystem Intelligence: Mapping the full operating environment to reveal hidden value, risk and opportunity
- AI Architecture: Building the intelligence foundations that make AI investments create real business value  
- Value Creation: Identifying and unlocking where value is created, captured and lost
- Sustainability Economics: Transforming sustainability from compliance into commercial advantage
- Supply Chain Intelligence: Building resilient, intelligent supply chains as strategic assets
- Transformation & Leadership: Delivering transformation programmes that create measurable outcomes

## Key Concepts

Ecosystem Intelligence is the practice of connecting data, technology, operations, sustainability, supply chains, markets and leadership insight to create a complete understanding of organisational performance.

Intelligence Architecture is the layer that connects data, operations, AI and decision-making — what makes AI investments deliver real business value rather than accelerating existing inefficiencies.

Better Intelligence. Better Decisions. Better Outcomes. Where Intelligence Creates Value.
